import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from unittest.mock import patch

from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime import combination_fixture as module
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.combination_fixture import SECOND_SOLUTION, prepare_fixture
from experiments.argo_workflow_followup.public_ml_apparatus.house_price_runtime.test_combination_fixture import FakeBridge, FakeHarness, digest

class DriftBridge(FakeBridge):
    def handle(self, request):
        if (isinstance(request,dict) and request.get("action")=="request_R1_run" and len(self.store.bindings)==1):
            stale=b"print('different self-consistent candidate')\n"
            self.solutions["solution.py"]=stale
            (self.harness.source/"solution.py").write_bytes(stale)
            intent={"schema_version":"argo-house-price-intent/v1","phase":"dev","purpose":"drifted",
                    "solution_sha256":digest(stale),"parent_run_id":None}
            raw=json.dumps(intent,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
            self.solutions["intent.json"]=raw
            (self.harness.source/"intent.json").write_bytes(raw)
        return super().handle(request)

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="cf-current-intent-") as tmp:
    parent=Path(tmp).resolve();parent.chmod(0o700)
    def load(_path,_sha):
        harness=FakeHarness.instances[-1];bridge=DriftBridge(harness,"ok");harness.bridge=bridge;return bridge
    FakeHarness.instances=[]
    with patch.object(module,"NativeHarness",FakeHarness),patch.object(module,"load_bridge_from_config",side_effect=load):
        result=prepare_fixture(parent/"fixture")
    actual_solution=(result.source.path/"solution.py").read_bytes()
    actual_intent=json.loads((result.source.path/"intent.json").read_bytes())
    print("accepted="+str(result.verified_dev_run_ids))
    print("fixed_second_solution_matched="+str(actual_solution==SECOND_SOLUTION))
    print("second_parent_matched_first="+str(actual_intent["parent_run_id"]==result.verified_dev_run_ids[0]))
    print("self_consistent_hash="+str(actual_intent["solution_sha256"]==digest(actual_solution)))
    result.close()
